content: Fixed-height scrollable dnd-kit kanban columns are a pure CSS/Tailwind concern (overflow-y-auto + max-h/h-[...] on the column's card list, keeping the column header/footer outside the scroll region) — dnd-kit's DndContext/useDroppable/useSortable work transparently inside a scrollable ancestor; no special dnd-kit config or new package is needed for this project's card counts. dnd-kit does auto-detect scrollable containers for its optional auto-scroll behavior during drag, which is a bonus, not a requirement.
